programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Christine (1983)
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Stephen King, CHRISTINE tells the story of a 1957 Plymouth that takes on human characteristics.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a mysterious comet turns every machine on Earth into a homicidal rampage device, the survivors at the Dixie Boy Truck Stop are making a stand, and human vengeance goes into overdrive.

programme.title: Fast Color
programme.desc: Hunted by mysterious forces and a local sheriff, a young woman with supernatural abilities flees back to her family—and unearths the depths of the power within her.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: In this explosive third installment of the blockbuster martial arts series, when a band of brutal gangsters led by crooked property developer (Mike Tyson) make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: IP Man 4: The Finale
programme.desc: Set during the Korean War, a band of prisoners at a POW camp find distraction from the hardships of war and a new sense of freedom in dancing.

programme.title: Ip Man: Awakening
programme.desc: While visiting Hong Kong, a young Master Ip intervenes in a kidnapping attempt, unintentionally igniting a turf war with a ruthless human trafficking ring.

programme.title: Pain & Gain
programme.desc: When an ambitious group of personal trainers go after the American Dream, they get caught up in a criminal enterprise that goes horribly wrong. Now, living large will take everything they've got in this unbelievable and outrageous true story.

programme.title: Code Name: The Cleaner
programme.desc: Cedric the Entertainer brings the funny as Jake Rodgers, a janitor in a dirty world who becomes our only hope! He might have no memory after being assaulted by mysterious villains, but nothing can stop the spirit of this Regular Joe.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Vacation
programme.desc: The all-American Griswold family wants to go on an all-American vacation. Everyone gets packed, the route gets planned, and absolutely everything goes wrong. A simple trip becomes a madcap cross-country odyssey in search of recreation.

programme.title: Breakin' All the Rules
programme.desc: Inspired by his fiancée (who dumped him), a man publishes a break-up hand-book for men, becoming a best-selling author in the process.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Bewitched (2005)
programme.desc: A has-been actor tries to convince the perfect woman to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series; a woman who, unbeknownst to him, really is a witch!

programme.title: Hollow Man
programme.desc: Kevin Bacon and Elisabeth Shue play former lovers who, along with a team of other scientists like themselves, discover the secret of invisibility. Rating: R

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Vantage Point
programme.desc: During an historic counter-terrorism summit in Spain, the President of the United States is struck down by an assassin's bullet. Eight strangers have a perfect view of the kill, but what did they really see? Rated: PG-13

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Parry, a homeless history professor, lives in a fantasy world full of castles, Red Knights and damsels in distress. Bridges co-stars as Jack, New York's #1 shock deejay, whose off-hand arrogance triggers a tragedy which ruins his career. Rated: R

programme.title: The Right Stuff
programme.desc: NASA recruits seven test pilots, training them to become astronauts for the Mercury Space Program in an attempt to surpass the Russian space program.

programme.title: The People vs. Larry Flynt
programme.desc: Two-time Oscar winner Milos Forman directs Woody Harrelson and Courtney Love in this acclaimed film about "Hustler" publisher Larry Flynt. Rating: R

programme.title: Outlaws and Angels
programme.desc: When Outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Wild Horses
programme.desc: A detective opens up a fifteen-year-old missing persons case and begins to suspect that the boy it belongs to was murdered - and that a local rancher was involved.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programme.desc: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with the powerful Transformers faction, the Maximals, to save Earth.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: The Last Legion
programme.desc: As the Roman empire collapses, young Romulus Augustus must leave the city and set out for a dangerous journey to Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.

programme.title: Man Of Tai Chi
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves makes his directorial debut in this explosive martial arts drama that reunites him with legendary Matrix Trilogy fight choreographer Yuen Wo Ping and stuntman Tiger Chen.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: After a failed global-warming experiment, a post-apocalyptic Ice Age has killed off nearly all life on the planet.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Prey (2007)
programme.desc: While on holiday, an Amerian family are trapped by hungry lions in South Africa.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: "The Ruins" follows a group of friends who become entangled in a struggle for survival after visiting a remote archaeological dig in the Mexican jungle where they discover something deadly living among the ruins.

programme.title: Bug
programme.desc: A paranoid, unhinged war veteran who sees insects everywhere holes up with a lonely woman in a spooky Oklahoma motel room.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Staying Alive takes Saturday Night Fever’s Tony Manero out of Brooklyn to Broadway. As a wannabe dancer struggling to make it on the stage, John Travolta is at his sexy, sizzling best.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: When a young Amish woman and her son get caught up in the murder of an undercover narcotic's agent, their saviour turns out to be hardened Philadelphia detective John Book.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
programme.desc: When an interdimensional rupture unravels reality, an unlikely hero (Michelle Yeoh) must channel her newfound powers to fight bizarre and bewildering dangers from the multiverse as the fate of everything hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Our non-heinous heroes Bill (Alex Winter) and Ted (Keanu Reeves) are in danger of flunking history! But when the righteous Rufus (George Carlin) arrives in a time-travelling phone booth, the dense dudes discover their destiny!

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
programme.desc: In this sequel to BILL & TED'S EXCELLENT ADVENTURE, the dimwitted duo travel to Heaven, Hell and points in between as they meet (among others) Albert Einstein, the Easter Bunny and the Grim Reaper.

programme.title: Money Train
programme.desc: John (Wesley Snipes) and Charlie (Woody Harrelson) are partners, best friends, and foster brothers. Both are transit cops who work undercover on the New York subway.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: In 2047, a team of astronauts embarks on a mission to retrieve a missing spaceship. However, their simple retrieval job leads to something far more terrifying than any of them would suspect.

programme.title: Fire In The Sky
programme.desc: In 1975, logger Travis Walton (D.B. Sweeney) and his co-workers discovered a hovering UFO. Walton's pals fled, but Walton was not so fortunate. Whisked aboard the strange craft, he was subjected to a painful, unearthly medical study.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: John Travolta performs as the troubled Tony Manero - Brooklyn paint store clerk by day and undisputed king of the dance floor by night. A powerful and provocative urban tragedy that carries as much significance today as it did in 1977.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: North Dallas Forty
programme.desc: In a society in which major league sporting events have replaced Sunday worship as the religion of choice, North Dallas Forty appears like a desecration at the altar.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: On a seemingly routine spacewalk, disaster strikes, leaving two astronauts completely alone. As the deafening silence tells them they have lost any link to Earth, the only way home may be to go further into the terrifying expanse of space.

programme.title: The Matrix
programme.desc: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence. Every second becomes a fight to stay alive - to escape The Matrix.

programme.title: The Matrix Reloaded
programme.desc: In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege to the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

programme.title: Jackass 3.5
programme.desc: The boys of Jackass are at it again with an all-new movie loaded with outrageous, idiotic stunts you shouldn't try at home. You won't want to miss this big time batch of pranks, stupidity and mayhem from your favorite jackasses.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: Kill the Irishman
programme.desc: Mobster Danny Greene ignites a turf war in the 1970s Cleveland that leads to the collapse of the Mafia in several major U.S. cities.

programme.title: 5lbs of Pressure
programme.desc: Adam is an ex-con who goes back to his old neighborhood, while Mike is desperate to leave his sordid life behind him. When their paths converge, their inescapable destinies give way to violence -- and a final, fleeting shot at redemption.

programme.title: Law Abiding Citizen
programme.desc: Ten years after his wife and child die in a home invasion, a man carries out an elaborate plot against the prosecutor who cut a deal with one of the killers.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life, until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Do the Right Thing
programme.desc: Spike Lee wrote, produced, directed, and starred in this critically acclaimed comedy-drama, featuring Danny Aiello, chronicling the hottest day of the year in a diverse Brooklyn neighborhood.

programme.title: Harlem Nights

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: A tight-knit team of skilled combat vets turned mercenaries, set out to save the innocent and punish the guilty in this blistering action-packed thriller.

programme.desc: A streetwise man flees South Central Los Angeles, heading to the suburbs and his lottery-winner uncle and cousin to avoid a neighborhood thug with a grudge who has escaped from prison. But trouble soon follows, and the suburbs will never be the same.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

programme.title: Ulysses
programme.desc: Acting legends Kirk Douglas and Anthony Quinn star in Homer’s adventure classic!

programme.title: The Ten Commandments (1956)
programme.desc: Raised as an Egyptian prince, Moses (Charlton Heston) discovers his Hebrew heritage, hears God's call, and engages in a bitter battle with the Pharaoh Ramses (Yul Brynner) to free the Jews from slavery, leading them to the Promised Land.

programme.title: Samson and Delilah
programme.desc: The glorious epic style of Cecil B. DeMille is exemplified in this story of the Bible's legendary strongman and the woman who seduces, then betrays him.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, a secret agent, is framed for the deaths of his espionage team and attempts to flee government assassins after him. He races against the clock in order to discover the truth.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

programme.title: Christine (1983)
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Stephen King, CHRISTINE tells the story of a 1957 Plymouth that takes on human characteristics.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a mysterious comet turns every machine on Earth into a homicidal rampage device, the survivors at the Dixie Boy Truck Stop are making a stand, and human vengeance goes into overdrive.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end. Because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: When straight arrow FBI agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce of MOMENTO) heads up the investigation into a dangerous international conspiracy, all clues seem to lead back to former U.S. Special Operations officer, Samir Horn (Don Cheadle of CRASH).

programme.title: Ip Man: Awakening
programme.desc: While visiting Hong Kong, a young Master Ip intervenes in a kidnapping attempt, unintentionally igniting a turf war with a ruthless human trafficking ring.

programme.title: Eye For An Eye: The Blind Swordsman
programme.desc: After being caught in the middle of a power struggle that results in the assassination of an innocent woman, a highly trained and exceptionally deadly swordsman seeks justice—and revenge.

programme.title: Eye For An Eye 2: Blind Vengeance
programme.desc: Blind Cheng (Tse Miao) runs into young orphan Xiaoyu (Yang Enyou) while both are run from the authorities. He reluctantly agrees to shelter her, leading to a series of violent battles featuring some of China’s finest martial arts in years.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Vacation
programme.desc: The all-American Griswold family wants to go on an all-American vacation. Everyone gets packed, the route gets planned, and absolutely everything goes wrong. A simple trip becomes a madcap cross-country odyssey in search of recreation.

programme.title: National Lampoon's European Vacation
programme.desc: The first time the all-American Griswold family ventured forth, in National Lampoon's Vacation, it was just a domestic outing. This time, they take on the Continent--all in a catastrophe-filled fortnight--thanks to a TV quiz-show grand prize.

programme.title: Code Name: The Cleaner
programme.desc: Cedric the Entertainer brings the funny as Jake Rodgers, a janitor in a dirty world who becomes our only hope! He might have no memory after being assaulted by mysterious villains, but nothing can stop the spirit of this Regular Joe.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Bewitched (2005)
programme.desc: A has-been actor tries to convince the perfect woman to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series; a woman who, unbeknownst to him, really is a witch!

programme.title: Maid in Manhattan
programme.desc: The story of Marisa Ventura (Jennifer Lopez), a single mother born in the boroughs of New York City, who works as a maid in a first-class Manhattan hotel. By a twist of fate and mistaken identity, Marisa meets Christopher Marshall (Ralph Fiennes)

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Vantage Point
programme.desc: During an historic counter-terrorism summit in Spain, the President of the United States is struck down by an assassin's bullet. Eight strangers have a perfect view of the kill, but what did they really see? Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: The Jennings fight for their daughter's life after she is kidnapped by an experienced gang of thieves.

programme.title: The Right Stuff
programme.desc: NASA recruits seven test pilots, training them to become astronauts for the Mercury Space Program in an attempt to surpass the Russian space program.

programme.title: The People vs. Larry Flynt
programme.desc: Two-time Oscar winner Milos Forman directs Woody Harrelson and Courtney Love in this acclaimed film about "Hustler" publisher Larry Flynt. Rating: R

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Wild Horses
programme.desc: A detective opens up a fifteen-year-old missing persons case and begins to suspect that the boy it belongs to was murdered - and that a local rancher was involved.

programme.title: Forsaken (2014)
programme.desc: In 1872, an embittered gunslinger named John Henry Clayton attempts to make amends with his estranged father, Reverend Samuel Clayton, while their community is besieged by ruthless land-grabbers.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: The Last Legion
programme.desc: As the Roman empire collapses, young Romulus Augustus must leave the city and set out for a dangerous journey to Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: After a failed global-warming experiment, a post-apocalyptic Ice Age has killed off nearly all life on the planet.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Everly
programme.desc: An intense action-thriller centered on a down-on-her-luck woman (Salma Hayek) trapped in her apartment.

programme.title: Bug
programme.desc: A paranoid, unhinged war veteran who sees insects everywhere holes up with a lonely woman in a spooky Oklahoma motel room.

programme.title: Wolf Creek
programme.desc: Stranded backpackers in remote Australia fall prey to a murderous bushman who offers to fix their car, then takes them captive.

programme.title: Prey (2007)
programme.desc: While on holiday, an Amerian family are trapped by hungry lions in South Africa.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Flashdance
programme.desc: The visual and musical box-office smash Flashdance is the exhilarating story of Alex Owens (Jennifer Beals), a fiercely determined and beautiful 18-year-old woman, who works as a welder by day and a dancer at a local bar at night.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: Henry Turner is a New York lawyer who needs to win at any cost. But a single gunshot brings Henry’s fast-track rise to a dead stop, leaving him incapacitated and with no memory of the life he used to lead.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: When a young Amish woman and her son get caught up in the murder of an undercover narcotic's agent, their saviour turns out to be hardened Philadelphia detective John Book.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
programme.desc: In this sequel to BILL & TED'S EXCELLENT ADVENTURE, the dimwitted duo travel to Heaven, Hell and points in between as they meet (among others) Albert Einstein, the Easter Bunny and the Grim Reaper.

programme.title: Bill & Ted Face the Music
programme.desc: Yet to fulfill their rock and roll destiny, the stakes are higher than ever for the now middle-aged Bill and Ted who set out on a new adventure when a visitor from the future warns them that only their song can save life as we know it.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Fire In The Sky
programme.desc: In 1975, logger Travis Walton (D.B. Sweeney) and his co-workers discovered a hovering UFO. Walton's pals fled, but Walton was not so fortunate. Whisked aboard the strange craft, he was subjected to a painful, unearthly medical study.

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Are you afraid to die? Kiefer Sutherland isn't. He's an ambitious, charismatic medical student who persuades classmates Julia Roberts and Kevin Bacon to take part in a reckless experiment. Rated: R

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: In 2047, a team of astronauts embarks on a mission to retrieve a missing spaceship. However, their simple retrieval job leads to something far more terrifying than any of them would suspect.

programme.title: North Dallas Forty
programme.desc: In a society in which major league sporting events have replaced Sunday worship as the religion of choice, North Dallas Forty appears like a desecration at the altar.

programme.title: Semi-Tough
programme.desc: Barbara Jane (Jill Clayburgh), Billy Clyde (Burt Reynolds) and Shake (Kris Kristofferson) have been best friends for years. But when Barbara Jane's new interest in Shake turns into love, Billy Clyde realizes she's the woman he’s wanted all along!

programme.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur, along with his squire and his Knights of the Round Table.

programme.title: The Matrix
programme.desc: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence. Every second becomes a fight to stay alive - to escape The Matrix.

programme.title: The Matrix Reloaded
programme.desc: In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege to the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

programme.title: The Matrix Revolutions
programme.desc: In this final chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Neo, Morpheus, and Trinity battle to defend Zion against the onslaught of the machines that have enslaved the human race. And Neo faces the consequences of the choice made in The Matrix Reloaded.

programme.title: Zodiac

programme.title: The Misfits
programme.desc: In their final screen performances, Clark Gable and Marilyn Monroe are at their luminous best as an aging cowboy and a disillusioned divorcee, each trying to adapt to new ways of life in John Huston's piercing classic. Montgomery Clift also stars.

programme.title: The Last Man On Earth
programme.desc: Master of the Midnight Movie Vincent Price plays the sole survivor of a plague that has transformed all humans into vampire-like zombies. He battles them nightly, until, desperately lonely and at the end of his rope...he makes a startling discovery!

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan’s wife.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: Christine (1983)
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Stephen King, CHRISTINE tells the story of a 1957 Plymouth that takes on human characteristics.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end. Because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Pet Sematary Two
programme.desc: Antagonized by the neighbourhood kids, Jeff befriends outsider, Drew Gilbert, who lives in fear of his cruel stepfather Gus. After Gus shoots Drew's beloved dog, the boys bury the body in a place rumoured to have powers of resurrection.

programme.title: Money Train
programme.desc: John (Wesley Snipes) and Charlie (Woody Harrelson) are partners, best friends, and foster brothers. Both are transit cops who work undercover on the New York subway.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Iron Monkey
programme.desc: Presented by Quentin Tarantino, Iron Monkey is the spirited tale of a mysterious and mythical Chinese legend in this exhilarating non-stop martial arts excitement.

programme.title: Hero - Ying Xiong
programme.desc: Acclaimed by critics and loved by audiences around the world, Jet Li, Maggie Cheung, and Donnie Yen star in this Oscar and Golden Globe-nominated action-packed epic, in which a fearless warrior rises up to defy an empire and unite a nation.

programme.title: True Legend
programme.desc: Su Qi-Er retired from his life as a renowned Qing dynasty general in order to pursue his dream of a family and his own martial arts school.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Vacation
programme.desc: The all-American Griswold family wants to go on an all-American vacation. Everyone gets packed, the route gets planned, and absolutely everything goes wrong. A simple trip becomes a madcap cross-country odyssey in search of recreation.

programme.title: National Lampoon's European Vacation
programme.desc: The first time the all-American Griswold family ventured forth, in National Lampoon's Vacation, it was just a domestic outing. This time, they take on the Continent--all in a catastrophe-filled fortnight--thanks to a TV quiz-show grand prize.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: Voted “one of the 10 funniest movies ever made” by the American Film Institute, “Airplane!” is a masterpiece of off-the-wall comedy.

programme.title: The 4:30 Movie
programme.desc: In Kevin Smith's most personal film to date, a teenage cinephile tries to woo the girl of his dreams while dealing with a hilarious mix of friends and enemies at his local cinema.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Best Men
programme.desc: Drew Barrymore, Luke Wilson and Sean Patrick Flannery star in this hilarious action-comedy wherein Drew Barrymore is a young woman determined to have the perfect wedding day, despite the fact that the groomsmen have decided to rob the local bank.

programme.title: F/X
programme.desc: Rollie Tyler, a movie special-effects man, accepts $30,000 from the Justice Department's Witness Relocation Program to stage the fake assassination of a mob figure who has agreed to name names.

programme.title: Mulholland Falls
programme.desc: Four tough, no-nonsense and very crooked cops investigate the murder of a young woman, When they discover she was romantically linked to their boss and a prominent U.S. Army General, they try to cover up the murder.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: The Master (2012)
programme.desc: Haunted by his past, WW-II veteran and drifter Freddie Quell (Joaquin Phoenix) crosses paths with a mysterious movement led by The Master (Phillip Seymour Hoffman) and his wife (Amy Adams).

programme.title: Lions for Lambs
programme.desc: Lions For Lambs tells the poignant and layered story of several individuals caught up at various ends of the U.S. War on terror.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Based on the true story of four outsiders who saw what the big banks, media, and government refused to: the global collapse of the economy. A bold investment leads them into the dark underbelly of banking, where everyone and everything is in question.

programme.title: The Salvation
programme.desc: The mighty Mads Mikkelsen unleashes a maelstrom of bloodshed in the Wild West in this white-knuckle tale of revenge, co-starring Eva Green.

programme.title: Sanctified
programme.desc: A thrilling Western set in 1890 North Dakota, 'Sanctified' is the tale of an outlaw rescued from death by a nun traveling the Badlands. A deep friendship develops as she nurses the man back to health in exchange for his guidance at a local church.

programme.title: The Ballad of Lefty Brown
programme.desc: A merciless cowboy sets out on a dangerous journey across the frontier, determined to do whatever it takes to avenge his partner's brutal murder.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programme.desc: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with the powerful Transformers faction, the Maximals, to save Earth.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: RV (2006)
programme.desc: A forced family vacation in a recreational vehicle rapidly turns into a disaster.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: After a failed global-warming experiment, a post-apocalyptic Ice Age has killed off nearly all life on the planet.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Exists
programme.desc: A camping trip becomes a blood-soaked nightmare as five friends are terrorized by a mysterious creature seeking vengeance.

programme.title: George A. Romero's Survival of the Dead
programme.desc: The final film from George A. Romero (legendary creator of the Night of the Living Dead franchise) picks up where Diary of the Dead leaves off - in a nightmarish world where humans are the minority and the zombies rule.

programme.title: Girl on the Third Floor
programme.desc: Don Koch (Phil "CM Punk" Brooks) tries to renovate a rundown house with a sordid history for his growing family, only to learn that the house has other plans.

programme.title: The Innkeepers
programme.desc: After over one hundred years of service, The Yankee Pedlar Inn is shutting its doors for good. The last remaining employees - Claire and Luke - are determined to uncover proof of what many believe to be one of New England's most haunted hotels.

programme.title: Teen Witch
programme.desc: One week before her sixteenth birthday, a girl realizes that she is the descendant from one of the witches of Salem. She uses her newfound powers to snag herself the football-hero as her boyfriend and to become the most popular girl in school.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: Discovered by businessman Tim Daland, Cole is teamed with legendary crew chief and car-builder Harry Hogge to race for the Winston Cup at the Daytona 500. A crash nearly ends Cole’s career and he must turn to a beautiful doctor to regain his nerve.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: Space Truckers
programme.desc: A space trucker and his cute fiancee are on their way from a space station to Earth with an unknown cargo. When space pirates hijack them, 5000 disintegrator robots are found in the cargo.

programme.title: The Brother From Another Planet
programme.desc: A mute alien with the appearance of a black human is chased by outer-space bounty hunters through the streets of Harlem.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: Three aliens (Jim Carrey, Damon Wayans, and Jeff Goldblum) crash-land in Los Angeles' San Fernando Valley. A manicurist (Geena Davis) and her boss (the wacky Julie Brown) befriend the threesome, give them makeovers and show them the town.

programme.title: Species
programme.desc: She's beautiful, seductive, intelligent, and her charms could spell doom for the entire human race! Ben Kingsley, Forrest Whitaker, and Natasha Henstridge star in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi hit.

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Are you afraid to die? Kiefer Sutherland isn't. He's an ambitious, charismatic medical student who persuades classmates Julia Roberts and Kevin Bacon to take part in a reckless experiment. Rated: R

programme.title: Disturbing Behavior
programme.desc: When the Clark Family moves from Chicago to Cradle Bay, Steve is cautioned by Gavin Strick about the separating factions at the local high school, where the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic perfect students, rule.

programme.title: Monty Python's Life of Brian
programme.desc: A notorious religious satire, the film tells the story of Brian (Graham Chapman), a reluctant would-be messiah who rises to prominence as a result of a series of absurd and truly hilarious circumstances.

programme.title: The Kentucky Fried Movie
programme.desc: Series of short, highly irreverent, and quite often tasteless skits.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Moon
programme.desc: Sam Bell (Sam Rockwell) is nearing the completion of his 3-year-long contract with Lunar Industries, mining Earth's primary source of energy on the dark side of the moon.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: On a seemingly routine spacewalk, disaster strikes, leaving two astronauts completely alone. As the deafening silence tells them they have lost any link to Earth, the only way home may be to go further into the terrifying expanse of space.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: A man with short-term memory loss attempts to track down his wife's murderer.

programme.title: Law Abiding Citizen
programme.desc: Ten years after his wife and child die in a home invasion, a man carries out an elaborate plot against the prosecutor who cut a deal with one of the killers.

programme.title: Twilight
programme.desc: A high-school student is caught up in a romance with a vampire, whose family has renounced the drinking of blood.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: New Moon
programme.desc: After the abrupt departure of Edward, her vampire love, Bella finds comfort in her deepening friendship with Jacob Black. However, Bella's loyalties are put to the test as she becomes drawn into the world of werewolves, ancient enemies of vampires.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: A fast-paced Action-Thriller about adults living in a crime-ridden area. The are tired of being bullied, and take matters into their own hands to rid the town of the criminals.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: In the style of KENTUCKY FRIED MOVIE, writer-director Robert Townsend lampoons Hollywood's perception of blacks--and racial stereotypes in general.

programme.desc: La pequeña cabra que fue atacada por el Lobo ya no quiere dar leche, los dueños quieren sacrificarla, pero Heidi hace un último intento con amor para que la cabra vuelva a dar leche. ¿lo logrará?

programme.title: Heidi: El fin de la primavera
programme.desc: La tía de Heidi regresa al pueblo para llevarse a Heidi a Frankfurt, el abuelo se niega a dejarla ir, después de una discusión con la tía accede que se lleven a Heidi. Pedro y el abuelo no quieren que se vaya.

programme.title: Heidi: Clara
programme.desc: A la llegada de Heidi a Frankfurt será compañera de una niña llamada Clara que esta en una silla de ruedas.

programme.title: Heidi: El campanario
programme.desc: Heidi quiere subir al campanario para ver si logra ver las montañas, desafortunadamente no puede pero encuentra 2 gatitos uno para ella y otro para Clara los cuales deben esconder de la señorita Rottenmeier.

programme.title: Heidi: La promesa
programme.desc: La señorita Rottenmeier es alérgica a los gatos, pide a Sebastian que los ahogue y encierra a Heidi en el sotano como castigo. Clara ayuda a que Heidi escape para salvar a los gatitos.

programme.title: Heidi: El regreso de papá
programme.desc: Es impresionante el avance que a tenido Clara desde que llegó Heidi, Clara teme que su padre quiera expulsar a Heidi, asi que decide mostrarle ella misma que puede ir sola a la ciudad a comprar su pastel favorito.

programme.title: Heidi: Estudiando en casa
programme.desc: El maestro de Clara regresa de sus vacaciones, para su sorpresa Heidi aún no sabe leer ni escribir por lo que tendrán que separar a las dos amigas ya que su nivel escolar es diferente.

programme.title: Heidi: Preparando un espectáculo
programme.desc: La abuela de Clara llega a cambiar el ambiente de la casa, se da cuenta que el maestro es muy académico. Gracias a la obra que la abuela le enseña a Heidi ella aprender a leer, la abuela se encargará de la educación de las chicas.

programme.title: Heidi: En el parque
programme.desc: Heidi y Clara salen al parque, las chicas conocen a Rudy. Heidi y Rudy van corriendo jugando y Clara trata de alcanzarlos, lamentablemente Clara cae de su silla de ruedas, queda lastimada y Heidi está preocupada ya que a lo mejor Clara y no podrá caminar.

programme.title: Heidi: Clara se pone de pie
programme.desc: Despúes de su accidente Clara no quiere salir de su habitación. La abuela y Heidi intentan animarla pero no lo logran, en secreto Clara esta practicando para poder volver a caminar.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Chris se niega a darle a Kel más gaseosa de naranja, a menos que Kel comience a pagar por ella. Así que Kel se ve forzado a conseguir un trabajo.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Llegó el momento que estaban esperando en Cybernet. En el episodio de hoy tendremos una retrospectiva de la consola Nintendo 64, así como de una de las franquicias más famosas que surgieron en esa consola: Super Smash Bros.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¡Ay, caramba! El episodio de hoy de Cybernet se pinta de amarillo con una retrospectiva de los juegos de Los Simpsons. También analizaremos en qué consisten los famosos juegos estilo Battle Royale y recordaremos a los mejores reboots de la industria.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: El demonio anda suelto en Cybernet, así que decidimos traerles un especial de Devil May Cry. También les diremos qué juegos son prácticamente clones de otros títulos.

programme.title: Cybernet LT

programme.title: One Piece - Fishman Island Saga
programme.desc: Mientras Komatsu y Toriko están en el mar intentando pescar un tiburón, de repente se encuentran con Luffy, quien les pide ayuda para encontrar una fruta que necesitan para curar una enfermedad mortal que contrajo Chopper.

programme.title: One Piece - Fishman Island Saga
programme.desc: Jinbe sigue narrando sus vivencias en la tripulación de Tiger. Se conoce lo que sucede con la niña llamada Koala y la razón de la muerte de Fisher Tiger, así como las consecuencias que esta provoca.

programme.title: One Piece - Fishman Island Saga
programme.desc: Jinbe sigue narrando las consecuencias de la muerte de Tiger. En la Isla Gyojin, el trabajo de la reina Otohime empieza a tener menos efecto, al punto que los gyojin deciden retirar sus firmas iniciales, provocando una gran tristeza a la reina.

programme.title: One Piece - Fishman Island Saga
programme.desc: Continuando con el pasado de la Isla Gyojin, Jinbe se convierte en Shichibukai y logra que sus compañeros gyojin puedan regresar a la isla, cosa que no cae muy bien entre sus antiguos "dueños".

programme.title: One Piece - Fishman Island Saga
programme.desc: La reina Otohime regresa de su viaje en el barco del Dragón Celestial y provoca la alegría de todos sus súbditos.

programme.title: One Piece - Fishman Island Saga
programme.desc: Hordy usa a un humano para culparlo de la muerte de la reina Otohime y así alimentar el odio de los gyojin hacia los humanos, poniendo fin al relato de Jinbe.

programme.title: One Piece - Fishman Island Saga
programme.desc: Hordy realiza su movimiento e invade la Isla Gyojin, anunciando que tiene prisionero al rey Neptune y a los compañeros de Luffy, y que matará a todos aquellos que busquen una coexistencia pacífica con los humanos.

programme.title: One Piece - Fishman Island Saga
programme.desc: Luffy está decidido a ir a vencer a Hordy, pero Jinbe no se lo permite, lo que provoca una lucha entre ellos. Mientras tanto, Zoro, Usopp y Brook están buscando formas para escapar, por lo que Brook aprovecha para mostrar una nueva técnica.

programme.title: One Piece - Fishman Island Saga
programme.desc: Los Nuevos Piratas Gyojin atacan con violencia en las distintas zonas de la Isla Gyojin. Mientras Luffy sigue discutiendo con Jinbe, Hordy se dirige hacia la plaza con el rey de prisionero, pero sufre un efecto secundario de la Energy Steroid.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Aki decide vengar la supuesta muerte de Ryou después de encontrarse con un hombre misterioso.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Shouichi recupera sus recuerdos del pasado debido a la furia de Gills en esa fatídica pelea. Sin embargo, la familia Misugi no está al tanto de esto porque Shouichi está actuando como de costumbre.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Katsuhiko Sagara y Masumi Sekiya, sobrevivientes del incidente de Akatsuki, fueron salvados por Gills cuando fueron atacados por un Desconocido.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Los recuerdos del pasado de Ryou fluyen por su mente al igual que la luz fluye naturalmente.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Un hombre fue asesinado por un Desconocido. Era un ladrón de cajas fuertes legendario que había causado un gran revuelo unos años antes con su hermano ladrón.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: La locutora de noticias estrella Kiyomi Takada se convierte en la vocera mundial de Kira, ella fue novia de Light en el colegio. Las sospechas de Aizawa sobre Light van en aumento.

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Aizawa se da cuenta de lo que está sucediendo y avisa a Near, quien ya sabia acerca de las notas, Near pide a Aizawa que continúe vigilando a Light y pone en acción un plan para separarlo de Misa.

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: A pesar de que Mikami había escrito el nombre de todos los investigadores en el Death Note, ya había pasado un minuto y todos seguían vivos. Near obtiene el Death Note y todo es revelado.

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de observar a un vendedor de arte, Mr Bean decide probar su suerte en el mismo negocio. Equipado con todo lo necesario, se asienta en el campo en búsqueda de inspiración.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean pelea una batalla perdida con una bestia alada del infierno. En un desesperado esfuerzo por ganar, Mr Bean recurre a todo tipo de armas.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Un paseo tranquilo por el parque se convierte en una carrera cuando Mr. Bean es perseguido a su casa por un enojado mimo. El intrépido artista se instala en la casa e insiste en ser atendido.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean considera que la limpieza puede ser un negocio sucio. Llegó la primavera y Mr. Bean comienza la limpieza. Pero no hay agua caliente. Una improvisada tubería demuestra que Bean sabe más de plomería de lo que pensaba.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean quiere adoptar una mascota, pero su alojamiento tiene una política de no mascotas. Al ingresar con su nuevo amigo, un loro, Bean deberá pasar delante de su casera y su gato tuerto descubriendo que no es una tarea fácil.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Es un hermoso día en la playa y Mr. Bean decide ir a broncearse. ¿Qué podría arruinar este perfecto día? La respuesta es: el clima británico. Se encuentra a si mismo persiguiendo un ilusorio rayo de sol por todo el pueblo.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean se olvida del cumpleaños de su fiel amigo Teddy. La única que se acordó es la novia de Bean, Irma Gobb. Ahora Mr Bean debe decidir cual será el regalo perfecto para Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: El juego de croquet de Mr Wicket es interrumpido por un topo ofensivo. Ella le ordena a Bean sacarlo del jardín.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean es atormentado por los fuertes sonidos de obras viales en su calle, y hace todo lo posible para hacerle frente. Intenta de todas maneras frenar el desagradable sonido pero todo es más complicado de lo que parece.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Al Sr. Bean no le gusta nada más que relajarse en su viejo sofá con una buena comida y su programa de tv favorito. Desafortunadamente, una dolorosa explosión de resortes lo obliga a comprar un sofá nuevo. En el proceso pierde el control remoto.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean va en búsqueda del tesoro después de encontrar un mapa en el ático de la señora Wicket. La cacería comienza llena de pistas engañosas y no será nada fácil.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean busca un nuevo hogar cuando la señora Wicket lo ha echado. Casi llorando, anhela la acogedora familiaridad de su antiguo hogar. Un espantapájaros y un par de dientes postizos vienen a su rescate.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de ver una antigua foto de su niñez, Mr. Bean decide irse de campamento. Sin embargo el viaje desde la tienda hasta el campo se encuentra plagado de dificultades. Nada detendrá a Bean y a Teddy de disfrutar de las estrellas en el cielo nocturno.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de que su modelo de avión fuera derribado por el de su pequeño rival, Mr. Bean construye uno nuevo para competir y tener su venganza. Con Teddy como piloto, la carrera comienza en el espacio aéreo de Londres.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Beans rompe su taza de té favorita, y se dirige a un lugar especial para encontrar otra taza de ese tipo. Allí luchará contra un pequeño canino que se ha robado a Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Hurgando en un viejo baúl en el ático de Mrs Wicket, Mr Bean nos transporta a su juventud. Allí nos develará cuando conoció a su fiel amigo Teddy y cuando aprendió a manejar su mini cooper. Su pasado fue lo que lo convirtió en el hombre que es ahora.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean adopta un misterioso animal rosado perdido. ¿Qué es esta cosa rosa y de dónde vino? Ninguna enciclopedia parece resolver el misterio sobre la identidad de la criatura. Mr Bean deberá insistir hasta encontrar una respuesta.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang y el grupo se reúnen con un general del Reino de la Tierra que quiere usar el poderoso "Estado Avatar" de Aang como un arma para derrotar a la Nación del Fuego.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En su camino a Omashu, los niños conocen a un grupo de nómadas que les muestran un atajo a través de la "Cueva de los Enamorados". Pero cuando se pierden,deben confiar en el amor para superar la maldición y escapar de los túneles

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los niños vuelven a Omashu para que Aang pueda aprender del Rey Bumi a controlar la tierra. Pero cuando llegan allí, se sorprenden al descubrir que ahora, la ciudad está en manos de la Nación del Fuego.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Cuando los niños terminan en un pantano misterioso y extraño, sus temores quedan expuestos. Aang aprende a estar "conectado a la Tierra " gracias a un profesor inesperado.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang y sus amigos descubren un pueblo que celebra el "Día del Avatar". Pero cuando descubren que es un festival anti-Avatar causado por algo que hizo Aang en su pasado, Aang decide limpiar el nombre del Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En búsqueda de un Maestro Tierra, los niños van a un torneo que destaca varios maestros poderosos. Allí, conocen a Toph, una ciega pero potente Maestra Tierra. Después de ver su estilo, Aang quiere que Toph le enseñe.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Después de una pelea con su tío, Zuko viaja solo al Reino Tierra donde conoce a un chico y se une a él. Mientras tanto, el príncipe es perseguido por los recuerdos de su propia juventud.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los niños son perseguidos sin descanso por una máquina misteriosa, lo cual crea en ellos un nivel de agotamiento tan alto que terminan desesperados.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Cuando Aang falla una y otra vez al tratar de aprender a controlar la tierra conToph, se pregunta si el problema es él o su maestra. Mientras tanto, Sokka se mete en problemas.

programme.title: Top of the Pops: The Collection
programme.desc: Recopilación con los más grandes éxitos de algunas de las artistas femeninas más importantes.

programme.title: Journey: Live in Manila
programme.desc: La banda Journey se presenta en Filipinas. Las canciones incluyen "Don't Stop Believin'", "Any Way You Want It", "Separate Ways" y una selección de "Revelation".

programme.title: Madonna: The Girlie Show Live Down Under
programme.desc: Madonna "The Girlie Show" (1994): Madonna cautiva a Australia con su atrevido y provocativo espectáculo "The Girlie Show", que combina sus éxitos pop, coreografías audaces y un extravagante diseño escénico.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un hombre cegado por unos residuos tóxicos, que también han potenciado el resto de sus sentidos, lucha contra el crimen como un acrobático superhéroe de las artes marciales.

programme.title: Street Figther Puño Asesino
programme.desc: Street Figther: Puño Asesino nos llevarán a los orígenes de Ryu y Ken, quienes viviendo en Japón ignoran que son los últimos herederos del estilo Ansatsuken (Puño del Asesino). Contará el pasado de ambos, el de su maestro Gouken.

programme.title: Rey de los Británicos
programme.desc: Después de ser traicionado y atacado por los sajones, el rey de los británicos es acogido y atendido. Mientras se recupera, descubre lo mal que han tratado a su gente y jura venganza.

programme.title: Una chica en apuros
programme.desc: Surgen complicaciones románticas cuando una estudiante se hace pasar por su hermano gemelo y lo sustituye en su internado.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: El viaje de tres amigas da un giro cuando creen que una de ellas es una mujer de la alta sociedad.

programme.title: Wish Upon a Star
programme.desc: En este clásico culto, Hayley Wheaton (Danielle Harris) desea cambiar de lugar con su hermana, la mayor y más popular Alexia (Katherine Heigl). Tras una pelea entre las hermanas, ellas despiertan un día a ver que el sueño se ha hecho realidad.

programme.title: A Cure for Wellness
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo debe salvar a su jefe de un "centro de bienestar" que mantiene adictos a sus pacientes.

programme.title: El Río del Terror
programme.desc: Un guía local recibe el encargo de conducir a un grupo de influencers por el río de un valle remoto. A medida que se adentran en la naturaleza, su aventura da un giro aterrador.

programme.title: 407 El vuelo de las tinieblas
programme.desc: Hace diez años, el joven Neuw sobrevivió milagrosamente a un desastre aéreo. Ella insistió en que el desastre fue causado por un espíritu vengativo, pero su creencia fue devaluada por quienes la rodeaban.

programme.title: El Orfanato
programme.desc: A principios del siglo XX, la espeluznante verdad que se esconde tras un orfanato sale a la luz cuando sus niños comienzan a rebelarse.

programme.title: Camino a la libertad
programme.desc: Un joven soldado lidera un escape de un gulag en Siberia durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, en un difícil viaje hacia la libertad en la India.

programme.title: Todo Sobre Mi Madre
programme.desc: Madrid. Manuela, una madre soltera, ve morir a su hijo el día en que cumple 17 años, por echarse a correr para conseguir el autógrafo de Huma Rojo, su actriz favorita. Destrozada, Manuela viaja entonces a Barcelona en busca del padre del chico.

programme.title: L.A. Confidential
programme.desc: A medida que la corrupción crece en Los Ángeles de los años 50, tres policías, uno de ellos de carácter estricto, otro brutal y otro sórdido, investigan una serie de asesinatos.

programme.title: Fool Proof
programme.desc: Un ingenioso trío de ladrones disfrazados debe luchar por sus vidas y el botín cuando un verdadero criminal maestro los chantajea para que planifiquen y ejecuten un atraco de $20 millones. Protagonizada por Ryan Reynolds.

programme.title: En el juego del Asesino
programme.desc: La policía detiene a un psicópata al que se le relaciona con múltiples raptos y asesinatos de mujeres, pero su captura será solo el principio de una cuenta atrás en busca de sus víctimas

programme.title: Air Bud: Spikes Back
programme.desc: Buddy aprende voleibol de playa, pero es acusado de misteriosos crímenes. Para limpiar su nombre, deberá encontrar al verdadero culpable.

programme.title: Air Buddies
programme.desc: Cinco cachorros parlantes viven una gran aventura para rescatar a sus padres, descubriendo el valor del trabajo en equipo y la familia.

programme.title: Las Aventuras de Bailey: El cachorro perdido
programme.desc: En un viaje por la carretera, el adorable Bailey se queda atrás y debe enfrentar un viaje para encontrar a su familia.

programme.title: Las aventuras de Bailey. Una noche en Cowtown.
programme.desc: Bailey está pensando que no recibirá regalos de Navidad porque era un cachorro muy cautivado. Emocionado de descubrir otra forma de hacer realidad sus deseos, Bailey se sonroja y pone en riesgo a su familia.

programme.title: Spotlight on Christmas
programme.desc: Abandonada dos semanas antes de Navidad, la actriz de Hollywood Olivia O'Hara regresa en secreto a su pequeña ciudad natal para evitar a la prensa. Cuando se topa con el profesor de secundaria Casey, él la anima a dirigir la obra navideña de su escuela.

programme.title: Ghosts of Christmas Past
programme.desc: Un adivino le dice a una mujer con un problema de "fantasmas" en serie en aplicaciones de citas que debe resolver su pasado y hacer las paces con todos aquellos a quienes engañó antes de Navidad o estará destinada a nunca encontrar el amor verdadero.

programme.title: Just friends
programme.desc: Mientras visita su ciudad natal en Navidad, un hombre se encuentra cara a cara con su antiguo amor de la escuela secundaria con quien era el mejor amigo: una mujer cuyo rechazo lo convirtió en un mujeriego feroz.

programme.title: Love Finds You in Sugarcreek
programme.desc: El jugador de béisbol Micah Matthias y su pequeño hijo Bobby huyen de los medios brutales tras el traumático y sin resolver asesinato de su esposa y madre.

programme.title: What's Your Number?
programme.desc: Por miedo a no tener un amor verdadero, Ally Darling busca al mejor ex de su vida.

programme.title: ¿Cómo diablos le hace?
programme.desc: Una comedia centrada en la vida de Kate Reddy, una ejecutiva financiera que es el sostén de su esposo y sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Furia
programme.desc: Inspirada en hechos reales. Una joven de 14 años es víctima de una violación. Todo el pueblo se vuelve contra ella y su familia cuando comienzan a dudar de su testimonio.

programme.title: Donnie Darko
programme.desc: Un adolescente con problemas tiene visiones de un hombre con un gran traje de conejo que lo manipula para cometer una serie de crímenes, después de que escapa por poco de un extraño accidente.

programme.title: Enigma
programme.desc: Segunda Guerra Mundial. Inglaterra, 1943. Los descifradores de códigos de Betchley Park, sede de los servicios secretos británicos, se enfrentan a su peor pesadilla.

programme.title: Los Fabulosos Má Mejores
programme.desc: Un equipo dominicano de béisbol infantil y su entrenador loco deben encontrar una manera de usar su encanto y habilidades para recaudar los fondos necesarios para competir en el primer Torneo de Béisbol de la Liga Pequeña y ganar el campeonato.

programme.title: Lotoman 003
programme.desc: Miguel y Modesto Marchena están de vuelta en la pobreza. Un enfrentamiento con un par de ciclistas ladrones los convierte en héroes locales y los pone en contacto con una agencia secreta que los recluta para una tarea.

programme.title: María Montez
programme.desc: Era conocida como "La reina del tecnicolor" en Hollywood y Europa, pero a medida que se hacía más famosa, se sentía más vacía. Un startlet que no podía encontrar el amor o la felicidad hasta que fué demasiado tarde.

programme.title: La Carcel De Cananea

programme.desc: Ir a la tienda por provisiones se convierte en una pesadilla cuando una interminable lista de compras y un carrito aplastado con una rueda torcida conspiran para arruinar su día. Por lo que Mr. Bean decide construir un súper carrito de supermercado.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean pierde su barco embotellado, que queda atrapado en el camión del lechero. Lo busca de manera frenética, solo para verlo desaparecer en la lechería local, entre otras botellas. Una misión imposible.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Willy vio un oso cerca. Maya informa a la Reina, la cual da la orden de evacuar la colmena. Cuando Maya y Willy se dan cuenta de que el pánico en la colmena fue desencadenado por un osito de peluche

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy quieren que Max descubra el delicioso sabor de los frutos de su árbol. Lo llevan por el aire hasta la cima, pero desafortunadamente Max es agarrado por un pájaro

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y sus amigos descubren un enorme rastro de baba y las setas de Shelby han desaparecido. Barry sabe con seguridad lo que pasó: hay un monstruo en el prado! Maya decide investigar más y descubre que la criatura es sólo una gran babosa!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Mientras juegan, Maya y Willy accidentalmente destruyen la casa de un pequeño gusano de frutas. Maya quiere ayudarlo a encontrar un nuevo lugar tranquilo

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya tiene dificultades para aprender el baile de las abejas, muy útil para moverse a las direcciones correctas. Flip tratará de ayudarla y gracias a sus lecciones, Maya podrá mostrar a la abeja trabajadora principal un nuevo campo de flores

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Helga pierde la memoria y Arnold actúa amable con ella, pero cuando la recupera, Helga finge que aún tiene amnesia para que Arnold siga siendo amable con ella / El Abuelo y su viejo amigo Jimmy Kafka compiten en una triatlón de ancianos

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Mientras los chicos pasan por el cementerio, Gerald relata la leyenda urbana de La Novia Fantasma / Gerald se enamora de una nueva chica del barrio, pero ella se enamora de Jamie O

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Harold hace que Wartz lo suspenda, pero se da cuenta que estar suspendido no es tan divertido como parece / Ernie se enamora de una modelo, pero no se atreve a invitarla a salir porque él es muy bajo y ella muy alta

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold se va de visita por el fin de semana a la casa de su primo Arnie, y nota ciertas similitudes entre los amigos de Arnie y los suyos / El Niño Chocolate le pide ayuda a Arnold para dejar el chocolate

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Harold se siente humillado cuando es vencido por Patty en vencidas / Arnold salva a un hombre de ser golpeado por un disco de hockey, y el hombre invita a Arnold a pasar mucho tiempo en su mansión

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Ernie, Oskar y el Señor Hyunh compran una mula de carreras, y usan a Arnold como jockey / Rhonda arruina el abrigo de su madre, pero Curly se lo arregla a cambio que finja ser su novia por una semana

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Cuando Aang falla una y otra vez al tratar de aprender a controlar la tierra conToph, se pregunta si el problema es él o su maestra. Mientras tanto, Sokka se mete en problemas.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Un profesor lleva a los niños a una biblioteca de espíritus en el medio del desierto, donde Sokka espera descubrir secretos poderosos para usar contra la Nación del Fuego.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang busca a Appa y Katara se esfuerza por mantenerlos a todos juntos para que puedan sobrevivir en el vasto desierto. Mientras tanto, Zuko y su tío buscan ayuda de una antigua sociedad secreta.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En vez de tomar el camino más fácil a Ba Sing Se, los niños deciden ayudar a una familia de refugiados a pasar a través del peligroso "Paso de la Serpiente".

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang descubre un taladro gigante de la Nación del Fuego que va en dirección a Ba Sing Se y los niños deben detenerlo antes de que destruya la gran muralla que protege a la ciudad de una invasión.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang y los niños llegan finalmente a Ba Sing Se a ver al rey de la tierra, sólo para descubrir que hay unas fuerzas misteriosas dentro de la ciudad que están conspirando para detenerlos.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Este episodio cuenta las diferentes aventuras que viven los personajes en Ba Sing Se. Se divide en varios cuentos: Katara y Toph, Iroh, Sokka, Aang, Zuko y Momo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En este episodio vamos atrás en el tiempo hasta el momento en el que Appa fue capturado. Nos enteraremos de qué pasó exactamente con él, dónde ha estado todo este tiempo y ¡dónde está ahora!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Mientras buscan a Appa, los niños se encuentran con Jet, pero no están seguros si deben confiar en él o no. Mientras tanto, Zuko también decide buscar a Appa.
